title: Line Segment
description: Draw a white line with rounded ends from (-0.6, -0.3) to (0.6, 0.3) on a black background. The line reaches 0.08 to each side of its path. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: Project the pixel onto the line with dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), where pa is the pixel minus the start and ba is the end minus the start. clamp() that to 0 to 1 so the projection stays on the segment. The distance to the segment is length(pa - ba * h). Subtract 0.08 for the thickness.
